ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixel distribution with approximately 20-30% high-intensity (white/grey) pixels localized in the inferior quadrants near the water line.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid black pigmentation across the superior and medial regions; irregular, diffuse white/light-grey mottling mapped to the inferior-medial coordinates of both lobes, following a non-linear boundary.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal pixel angle of approximately 50 degrees relative to the lobe axes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous jagged boundary; right lobe exhibits high-frequency serration peaks (approx. 8-10 distinct points); left lobe displays more uniform, lower-amplitude serrations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curvature along the lateral margins terminating in acute, upward-pointing distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast, irregular clusters of light-colored pixels situated at the extreme lateral terminal points of both fluke lobes, corresponding to external calcified growths.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint vertical striations intersecting the primary black pigment on the left lobe, approximately mid-way between the central notch and the distal tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Physical protrusions of high-contrast material (barnacle clusters) localized at the apical tips of both fluke lobes.
